channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: TGSRTC Rolls Out 6,431 Special Buses to Manage Sankranthi Rush Across Telangana
item.description: TGSRTC rolls out 6,431 Special buses for Sankranthi to manage heavy travel rush, peak dates, special services from Hyderabad hubs, fare rules, and free travel for women.

item.title: Delhi Riots Case: Four Accused Released from Jail After Bail from SC
item.description: Delhi riots case update: Four accused released from jail after bail from the Supreme Court, following court verification and strict bail conditions.

item.title: Four students killed as car rams into tree near Hyderabad
item.description: Birthday celebrations turned tragic as four students were killed and another critically injured when an SUV in which they were travelling rammed into a tree near Hyderabad early Thursday, police said.

item.title: CM Stalin inaugurates distribution of Rs 3,000 cash, Pongal gift hampers in Chennai
item.description: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin on Thursday inaugurated the statewide distribution of Pongal gift hampers and Rs 3,000 cash assistance for more than 2.22 crore rice ration card holders and eligible Sri Lankan Tamil families in Tamil Nadu.

item.title: Bangladesh polls: Islamist alliance in turmoil as Jamaat, Islami Andolan clash over seats
item.description: As Bangladesh heads towards the February election, the task of finalising a seat-sharing arrangement has become increasingly complicated within the radical Islamist party Jamaat-e-Islami-led alliance, deepening uncertainty within the newly announced coalition, local media reported on Thursday.

item.title: Kerala Assembly Elections: Parties Aim High Even Before Dates Are Announced
item.description: The exercise was aimed at energising the organisation, ironing out internal differences and projecting confidence after the UDF’s improved showing in the December local body elections.

item.title: KIMS Kondapur launches Adult Vaccination Clinic
item.description: Inaugurating the clinic, Dr. Sudheer Vinnamala, Regional Medical Director, KIMS Hospitals, Kondapur, said that with increasing life expectancy, maintaining good health in later years has become crucial.

item.title: Yash Turns 40, Makers Unveil Powerful Look From ‘Toxic’
item.description: As rockstar Yash rang in his 40th birthday on Thursday, the makers of his upcoming film Toxic: A Fairytale for Grown-Ups marked the occasion by revealing a striking glimpse of his character, Raya raw, bold and unapologetically intense.

item.title: Only thing I wanted was to finish off with a win’: Khawaja after farewell Test at SCG
item.description: Australia’s five-wicket win in the fifth and final Test at the Sydney Cricket Ground on Thursday meant the most for Usman Khawaja, who walked off the field for one last time in his career, having announced his retirement a couple of days before the game began.

item.title: Member of Rajesh Bawania gang arrested after police encounter in Delhi
item.description: The operation was carried out by the Delhi Police Special Cell, which targeted members of the Rajesh Bawania gang, a criminal network that has remained on the radar of law enforcement agencies for a long time due to its involvement in serious offences.
